questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The plot of the novel is very __dull__.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **4) Riveting**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The word “dull” means boring, uninteresting, or lacking excitement.
 
• An antonym should therefore convey the opposite meaning—very interesting or exciting.
 
 
• Charming – pleasant or attractive, but not necessarily exciting ❌ 
 
• Diverting – entertaining, but comparatively mild ❌
 
• Plodding – slow and boring (similar to dull) ❌
 
• Riveting – extremely interesting and exciting ✅
 
 
 
• Hence, “riveting” is the most appropriate antonym of “dull.”

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Everyone should be aware of the possibly greater __potential__ for natural disasters where they live and what resources they have in case these happen.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Certainty**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence talks about being aware of the possibility of natural disasters.
 
• **Potential: **The capability or possibility for something to happen or develop; having the capacity or ability. (किसी चीज़ के घटित होने या विकसित होने की क्षमता या संभावना; क्षमता या योग्यता होना)
 
 
• **Example**: *His potential as a leader became evident when he successfully led the team to victory.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Certainty: **The state of being certain, sure, or confident about something; the quality of being definite or unquestionable. (किसी चीज़ के बारे में निश्चित, सुनिश्चित या आश्वस्त होने की अवस्था; निश्चित या निर्विवाद होने का गुण)
 
 
• **Example**: *The scientific experiment yielded conclusive results, providing a high level of certainty about the hypothesis.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of 'potential' is 'certainty'.

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maze**: A complex network of paths or passages. (पथों या मार्गों का एक जटिल नेटवर्क)
 
• **Knot**: A fastening made by tying a piece of string, rope, or something similar. (डोरी, रस्सी या ऐसी ही किसी वस्तु को बांधकर बनाया गया बंधन)
 
• **Neuter**: Having no gender. (जिसका कोई लिंग न हो)

• **"Abstinence" **refers to the act of voluntarily refraining from indulging in something, usually pertaining to pleasurable activities like eating certain foods or drinking alcohol.

• **Celibacy:** This refers to the state of abstaining from marriage and sexual relations. It is actually a form of abstinence(ब्रह्मचर्य)
 
• **Continence:** This is the ability to control movements of the bowels and bladder, but it can also mean self-restraint or abstinence, especially in regard to sexual activity.(संयम)
 
• **Control: **This refers to the power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events. (नियंत्रण)

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Acclimatise
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Disarrange**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Acclimatise **means to adjust or adapt to a new environment, climate, or situation. (अभ्यस्त)

 
 
• **Example**: *After moving from the tropics to a colder climate, it took Joy a few weeks to acclimatise to the chilly weather.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Disarrange **means to disturb the order or arrangement of something, causing it to be in a state of disorder or confusion. (गड़बड़ करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The mischievous children managed to disarrange the carefully organized books on the shelves.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prioritise: **To organize or deal with things in order of importance, giving preference or precedence to certain tasks, issues, or goals. (प्राथमिकता)
 
• **Placate: **To calm, pacify, or appease someone, typically by making concessions or soothing gestures to alleviate anger, resentment, or discontent. (तसल्ली देना)
 
• **Decriminalise: **To remove or reduce the legal penalties or restrictions associated with a particular activity, making it no longer a criminal offence. (नाक़ाबिल ताज़ीर क़रार देना)
